pr_body:
##### Summary
Implement a Prometheus exporter web API as a part of the backends refactoring project #6762.

Closes #7177

##### Component Name
backends, exporting engine

##### Test Plan
- Revert the commit "Disable the new code" to test the new code.
- Get data using the Prometheus web API request http://localhost:19999/api/v1/allmetrics?format=prometheus

My configuration in the `exporting.conf`
```
[exporting:global]
enabled = yes
send configured labels = yes
send automatic labels = yes
update every = 3

[prometheus:exporter]
send charts matching = system.processes
```

##### Additional Information
The new exporter will be disabled until the new exporting engine finally replaces backends.

review_comments: Here we have more notorious what I said above, during the tests you are sending both `configured labels` and `automatic labels`.

Only to confirm, this is the unique condition that by default won't set by default the flag, for all others you are always enabling, is this expected? Because you are sending `configured labels`, but you are ignoring the `automatic labels`.
No. Every connector has [disabled automatic labels](https://github.com/netdata/netdata/blob/master/exporting/read_config.c#L336) by default.
You are using `calloc` without to verify the return, please, add a test here.
